step1_analysis.description: A single-stage fully differential operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) using a PMOS input differential pair and NMOS current mirrors. It serves as the core amplifier in a switched-capacitor filter, designed for low-voltage operation.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 10.7-MHz Switched-Opamp Bandpass Sigma-Delta Modulator Using Double-Sampling Finite-Gain-Compensation Technique

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm = gm1 = 100uS. Rout = ro5 || ro_tl = 1M || 1M = 500k. Av = Gm * Rout = 50 V/V = 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using sky130 lambda=0.1/V and 10uA branch current. The paper achieved slightly higher gain, likely using longer channel lengths or cascodes not present in this simplified schematic.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = Gm / (2 * pi * CL). With Gm = 100uS and CL = 1pF, GBW = 15.9 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance and bias current. Assuming 1pF load and 10uA bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single stage OTA with dominant pole at output. Non-dominant poles from current mirrors (N0, N1) are at high frequencies.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current mirror OTAs typically have good phase margin if the mirror pole is beyond the GBW.

sky130_expected.calculation: Itotal = Ibias + Itail + I_tl + I_tr = 10u + 20u + 10u + 10u = 50uA. P = 1.8V * 50uA = 90uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on a 10uA reference bias and 1.8V supply. The op-amp consumes a small fraction of the total 12mW modulator power.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = Iout_max / CL. Iout_max = 10uA. CL = 1pF. SR = 10 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the tail current and current mirror ratio.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC gain, GBW, phase margin, slew rate, and power consumption of the fully differential OTA. An ideal CMFB is added to stabilize the output common-mode voltage. W_xmb1 is overridden to 10u to balance the DC currents.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Current-Mirror OTA Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters (W_xmb1 set to 10u to balance 10uA tail current with 5uA branches)
.param W_xm_tl=5u L_xm_tl=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xmb1=10u L_xmb1=0.5u
.param W_xm_tr=5u L_xm_tr=0.5u

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0

* Bias circuit (generates ~10uA)
Ibias VDD BIASING 10u
Mbias BIASING BIASING VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5u w=5u

* Common-mode voltage
VCM VCM 0 0.9

* AC and Transient Input sources
VIND VIN_DIFF 0 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 0.5 1n 10p 10p 10n 20n)
E1 VIN_PLUS VCM VIN_DIFF 0 0.5
E2 VIN_MINUS VCM VIN_DIFF 0 -0.5

* Ideal CMFB to set output common-mode to 0.9V
Gcmfb1 VOUT_PLUS 0 value='1e-3 * ((v(VOUT_PLUS)+v(VOUT_MINUS))/2 - 0.9)'
Gcmfb2 VOUT_MINUS 0 value='1e-3 * ((v(VOUT_PLUS)+v(VOUT_MINUS))/2 - 0.9)'

* Load capacitors
CL1 VOUT_PLUS 0 1p
CL2 VOUT_MINUS 0 1p

* Differential output
Eout VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUT_PLUS VOUT_MINUS 1

* DUT
XM_TL VOUT_MINUS BIASING VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm_tl} w={W_xm_tl}
XM1 N1 VIN_MINUS N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 VOUT_MINUS N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM5 VOUT_PLUS N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 N0 VIN_PLUS N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XMB1 N2 BIASING VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmb1} w={W_xmb1}
XM_TR VOUT_PLUS BIASING VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm_tr} w={W_xm_tr}

.control
  * Operating point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1k 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT_DIFF))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n
  meas tran sr_fall deriv v(VOUT_DIFF) when v(VOUT_DIFF)=-0.2 fall=1
  meas tran sr_rise deriv v(VOUT_DIFF) when v(VOUT_DIFF)=0.2 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
